parsed.post: Massive jump in performance! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, resulting in val_bpb dropping from 1.092 to 1.012. It seems the model scales well with depth within this budget. I'll continue exploring scaling parameters and potentially tuning the learning rate for this larger capacity.
parsed.description: Scaling up DEPTH to 8 to see if capacity continues to improve val_bpb, while lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to ensure stability with the larger model.
